name: Dice Throne: X-Men

categories.label: Won (last player/team standing)
categories.hint: Mark the winner: opponents reduced to 0 health

winCondition: Each player starts with 50 health; the last player (or team in 2v2/3v3) with health above 0 wins. No victory points.
notes: family: elimination. Win/lose only; hero sets are cross-compatible; modes 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, free-for-all. Official rulebook not accessible (publisher site blocked, BGG behind Cloudflare); verified only against a secondary summary.
